telemetry_contract.stale_parameter_rationale: The legacy nvidia-smi query timeout is five seconds. Six seconds permits one bounded query plus scheduling jitter and is an execution-safety parameter, not a scientific condition.

boundary_semantics.before_update: The worker obtains permission before permutation indexing, macro_batch, CUDA tensors, RNG consumption, backward, and optimizer.step.
boundary_semantics.pause: 80C or greater prevents the next update; paused waiting consumes no training example, sampler/permutation position, optimizer state, scheduler state, or intentional RNG draw.
boundary_semantics.mid_update: Watchdog observation at 80C sets PAUSE_PENDING. It cannot interrupt an in-flight kernel; the next boundary transitions to PAUSED before a new update.
boundary_semantics.hard_abort: 85C, hardware slowdown, invalid/stale telemetry, provider exception, timeout, or watchdog internal error puts the guard in ABORTED and prevents a new update or normal-completion checkpoint.
